fact: On 28 January 2026 the director of the Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados Pessoais, José Costa Alegre, gave a press conference reviewing the agency's activities since its founding and its monitoring of public and private bodies' compliance.
title: Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados destaca progressos e alerta para riscos à privacidade digital
publisher: Rádio Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
